card.name: Flushing eyes after accidental contact
card.fires_on: The verb flush (or wash) right after an if-clause about eye or skin contact, where the next words say to rinse with water. Also fires on eyes in similar contact phrases.

modes.label: Flush after eye contact
modes.description: The instruction verb flush or wash comes just after a clause about the product touching the eyes.
modes.example: If malathion lotion comes into contact with the eyes,<< flush>> immediately with water.

modes.label: Eyes in exposure phrase
modes.description: The word eyes ends a contact phrase, just before the rinse instruction.
modes.example: In case of contact with skin or<< eyes>>, the affected area should be flushed immediately
